adjudication.rationale: Looking at app/assets/javascripts/embed.js line 7: `iframe.src = discourseUrl + "embed/best?embed_url=" + encodeURIComponent(discourseEmbedUrl);`. The code concatenates discourseUrl directly with 'embed/best'. If discourseUrl is 'https://host' (without trailing slash), the result would be 'https://hostembed/best' which is invalid. The code assumes discourseUrl ends with '/' but doesn't enforce or document this requirement. This is a real bug that would cause the embed functionality to fail if the URL doesn't have a trailing slash.
